```{r ,echo=F}
bsplus::bs_modal(id = "12",title = "mod_impute",size = "large",body = "_I_m_p_u_t_a_t_i_o_n _o_f _m_i_s_s_i_n_g _v_a_l_u_e_s\\n\\n_D_e_s_c_r_i_p_t_i_o_n:\\n\\n     This function imputes missing values using one of the implemented\\n     imputation methods.\\n\\n_U_s_a_g_e:\\n\\n     \\n         (\\n       object,\\n       which_data,\\n       method = 'rf',\\n       thresh = 0.3,\\n       path_to_diagnostics = NULL\\n     )\\n     \\n_A_r_g_u_m_e_n_t_s:\\n\\n  object: a S4 object of class 'metime_analyser'.\\n\\nwhich_data: a character defining which dataset should be imputed.\\n\\n  method: a character defining the method for imputation. See details\\n          for more information. Default set to 'rf'\\n\\n  thresh: a numeric defining at which missingness level metabolites\\n          will be excluded. Default set to 0.3 (30% missingness)\\n\\npath_to_diagnostics: a character defining the path to where a\\n          diagnostic file is being written.\\n\\n_D_e_t_a_i_l_s:\\n\\n     additional methods are currently not implemented such as knn, pmm,\\n     norm etc.\\n\\n_V_a_l_u_e:\\n\\n     S4 object of the class 'metime_analyser' with mutated col_data and\\n     row_data.\\n")
```

```{r ,echo=F}
bsplus::bs_modal(id = "14",title = "add_distribution_vars_to_rows",size = "large",body = "_A_d_d _p_h_e_n_o_t_y_p_i_c _m_e_a_s_u_r_e_m_e_n_t_s _t_h_a_t _a_r_e _n_o_t _a_d_d_e_d _t_o _t_h_e _r_o_w__d_a_t_a _o_f _t_h_e\\n_d_a_t_a_s_e_t\\n\\n_D_e_s_c_r_i_p_t_i_o_n:\\n\\n     A method applied on the s4 object of class 'metime_analyser' to\\n     add all those datapoints that are present in phenotype dataframe\\n     but not in row_data comes with the feature of updating those data\\n     points measured only at screening to all datapoints and then\\n     adding it to row_data\\n\\n_U_s_a_g_e:\\n\\n     \\n         (\\n       object,\\n       screening_vars,\\n       distribution_vars,\\n       which_data\\n     )\\n     \\n_A_r_g_u_m_e_n_t_s:\\n\\n  object: An object of class metime_analyser\\n\\nscreening_vars: A character vector to define the vars that are to be\\n          updated as per add_screening_vars() else set it to\\n          NULL(Default).\\n\\ndistribution_vars: A character naming the vars of interest\\n\\nwhich_data: dataset to which the information is to be added(only 1 can\\n          be used at a time)\\n\\n_V_a_l_u_e:\\n\\n     object of class metime_analyser with phenotype data added to row\\n     data\\n\\n_S_e_e _A_l_s_o:\\n\\n     add_screening_vars\\n\\n_E_x_a_m_p_l_e_s:\\n\\n     object <- \\n         (object=data, screening_vars=c('var1', 'var2'), \\n                     distribution_vars=c('var1', 'var2', 'var3'), which_data='dataset1')\\n     ")
```
